description: Repairs r-def-cat-txn/link-drop-delete-and-alter-link: the cached TableDefs plus the re-append of LK left two 'LK' entries, so TableDefs.Item('LK') failed (3298) and the rename and Delete steps never ran. A new ACCDB host is made; LK is linked (relative Connect) to T of the input r-def-cat-txn-lksrc-accdb. DROP TABLE LK (DBEngine.Errors right before and after); TableDefs is refreshed and listed and the source rows are counted; LK is appended again; ALTER TABLE LK ADD COLUMN W LONG and CREATE INDEX IX_LK ON LK (V) (DBEngine.Errors right before and after each); the fields and indexes of the source T through a second Database; the refreshed TableDefs; the link is renamed to LK2 through TableDef.Name (TableDefs refreshed first); TableDefs.Delete('LK2') (DBEngine.Errors); the refreshed catalog and the source rows.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
